No self-serve build-your-own hotpot bar exists on this delivery listing (not offered for delivery) -- the fixed 'Pre-Set Bowls' section is the platform's substitute for the core dish. Odd cent endings (.08/.38/.68/.23/.53/.83/.13/.43/.03) are a real $1.30/$2.60 modifier confirmed by the subtraction test on two independent series: Teriyaki combos (Chicken $14.23 -> +1.30 Shrimp $15.53 -> +2.60 Beef $16.83) and Pre-Set Bowls (base $22.08 -> +1.30 Skip The Soup $23.38 -> +2.60 Stir Fry Boss $24.68), not a computed/corrupted field. Divisor sweep 1.00-1.35 found no proportional markup landing >50% on round dollars.
